_about: Generated by analysis/measure.py from the bounces. James's takes are MP3-matched (192 kbps at 44.1 kHz, 15.7 kHz cutoff) and every take is normalized to -23.0 LUFS before measuring. Do not edit by hand.

settings.noise_floor: 5th percentile of 20 ms RMS frames (10 ms hop) over the whole file, dBFS at -23 LUFS (the brief's definition; in clone files it is set by trailing digital silence, so the page uses room_in_pauses and tail_median instead)
settings.tail_after_speech: RMS from 50 ms after the last word to the end of the file
settings.tail_median: median of 20 ms RMS frames from 50 ms after the last word to the end of the file (used for the clone; my bounces end with edit fades)
settings.tail_envelope: 20 ms RMS frames (10 ms hop) from 250 ms before the last word ends to the end of the file; t = 0 is the end of the last word (last frame above the speech threshold)
settings.fry_rule: a phrase is marked not comparable when more than 15% of either take's voiced frames are below 80 Hz
settings.octave_check: median harmonic spacing (spectrum autocorrelation) vs pYIN median; flagged when they differ by more than 3 semitones; run per phrase and over each whole line
settings.room_in_pauses: 20th percentile of the quiet 20 ms frames (at or below the speech threshold) inside pauses of 120 ms or more, skipping 30 ms at each pause edge, so breaths don't set it

low_end.note: '-er' windows: clone from the confirmed crackle callout; mine from where my pitch dips into the '-er' (approximate)
low_end.reference: 0 dB = my average 80-300 Hz level across the word (both takes at -23 LUFS)

rows.word: what are you in the mood for

formant_map.method: LPC formants and 3-4 kHz vs 0.3-1 kHz level, median over voiced frames
